items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: That's what I used to get after Kim, man.

ctx.x: But he didn't play with the real popular bands, Joe.
No. Me neither. That's what I'm saying. That's what I used to get after Kim, man. I ain't used to playing with them kind of fellas. I mean, no.
I thought Mealy played with Chris and Buddy and some of the fans.
